title: Transported etale geometric and scalar adjunction realization
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes and $\Lambda$ any commutative ring, in the coefficient and small-site universes of [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation]. For $T=X,Y$, let $J_T$ be the lifted small etale topology and $\Lambda_T$ its sheafified constant ring. Use the canonical site equivalence $E_T$ from the native to the lifted site, for set, ring and module sheaves. There exists an actual geometric and scalar-extension datum $d$ of [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data] with set inverse $E_Y^{-1}\circ f^{-1}\circ E_X$, set direct $E_X^{-1}\circ f_*\circ E_Y$, and their transported geometric adjunction. Its fixed-coefficient inverse and direct images are exactly the transported published module inverse and direct images, and its fixed-coefficient adjunction is the transported published module adjunction. The datum is exact in the sense of ExactData: both inverse images are additive, preserve finite limits and finite colimits, and preserve small colimits. It admits OrdinaryIdentification: the scalar-restriction comparisons of inverse and direct images preserve the displayed underlying direct-image comparison and the full ordinary adjunction Hom bijection. No finiteness, nonzero-ring or boundedness condition is imposed. This assertion contains no derived category or tensor comparison.

proof.text: Transport the set inverse and direct images and their actual geometric adjunction through the displayed site equivalences. Apply the constant-ring inverse-image construction, with its constant-section-preserving ring isomorphism. Construct module inverse image by scalar extension and module direct image by the geometric direct image with its induced action.

proof.text: The coefficient isomorphism contracts scalar extension. The underlying module inverse image is geometric inverse image, hence preserves finite limits; as a left adjoint it preserves colimits. Restricting the action to constants gives exactly the displayed transported fixed-coefficient functors and adjunction.

theorem etale_ringed_geometric_realization {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] :
    ∃ d : GeometricData (topology Y) (topology X) Λ,
      d.inverse = (presentationEquivalence Y (Type (u + 1))).inverse ⋙
        Scheme.etaleSetPullback f ⋙ (presentationEquivalence X (Type (u + 1))).functor ∧
      d.direct = transportedDirect f (Type (u + 1)) ∧
      HEq d.geometric
        ((presentationEquivalence Y (Type (u + 1))).symm.toAdjunction.comp
          ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).comp
              (presentationEquivalence X (Type (u + 1))).toAdjunction)) ∧
      ∃ (hL : d.pullA = transportedInverse f (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
        (hR : d.pushA = transportedDirect f (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        HEq d.fixedAdj
          ((nativeEquivalence Y Λ).symm.toAdjunction.comp
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).comp
              (nativeEquivalence X Λ).toAdjunction)) ∧
        ∃ _x : ExactData d, Nonempty (OrdinaryIdentification d)
